messages:
maria.docs: Heads-up — opened a short docs PR for SOC2 audit-log guidance: https://git.company/repos/docs/pulls/834
vikram.security: thanks, linking it now. what's the ask in one line?
maria.docs: we need a clear sentence that explains how we treat tenant identifiers in audit logs (pseudonymize vs redact) and two example snippets (curl + go) showing the SDK call that sets audit metadata
angelo.devex: saw the PR. one small thing — the internal link to the retention matrix is 404 in the current draft. I can patch it to the new matrix path if you want :hammer_and_wrench:
maria.docs: please patch it, thx. also added a proposed sentence: "By default Redwood pseudonymizes tenant and user identifiers in standard audit events; customers can enable full redaction via Tenant Settings (see retention matrix)." open to wording.
vikram.security: prefer: "By default, Redwood pseudonymizes user and tenant identifiers in operational audit events; customers who require full de-identification may enable redaction via Tenant Settings. See the retention matrix for per-region defaults and legal holds." (minor nit: use 'de-identification' not 'redaction' in SOC2 para)
sophie.legal: quick read — overall ok. change "enable redaction" -> "request redaction" (ops triggers, legal approval). Also add a parenthetical about subpoenas: "redaction does not alter audit trails needed for legal process'"
maria.docs: noted. I'll update to: "...customers who require full de-identification may request redaction via Tenant Settings (legal approval required). Redaction does not prevent disclosure when compelled by lawful process." sound good?
sophie.legal: yes
angelo.devex: for the snippet section I drafted two tiny examples. please check:

```
# curl example (audit producer)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/events \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"event_type":"user.login","tenant_pseudonym":"t-abc123","meta":{"ip":"1.2.3.4"}}'

// go example (using internal SDK)
client.Audit().WriteEvent(ctx, AuditEvent{
  Type: "user.login",
  TenantPseudonym: "t-abc123",
  Meta: map[string]string{"ip":"1.2.3.4"},
})
```

angelo.devex: aim was to show pseudonym field name and that metadata can be present; we shouldn't show any real token examples
maria.docs: these look good. can we add a one-line that shows a redaction request call (POST /v1/tenant/:id/redact) so customers know the flow?
vikram.security: yes include it but mark it as asynchronous and legal-approved flow. maybe:

```
POST /v1/tenant/:id/redact
Body: {"scope":"audit_events","since":"2023-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
Response: 202 Accepted
```

vikram.security: also add an ops note: redaction will remove identifiers from indexed fields but retain an internal audit trail for compliance (hashed reference)
maria.docs: ack — adding that language
angelo.devex: small formatting note: use backticks for field names in the prose (e.g., `tenant_pseudonym`) so it renders better in docs
maria.docs: good call
sophie.legal: one more legal phrasing: replace 'remove identifiers' with 'irreversibly de-identify' in the ops note.
maria.docs: updated. pushing new commit in a sec
ci-bot: CI: docs lint passed (commit f2a9b2). build #1207
maria.docs: ok CI good. @sophie.legal @vikram.security can you do final thumbs and I'll request merge?
vikram.security: :thumbsup:
sophie.legal: :white_check_mark:
maria.docs: merging after I fix the broken retention link (angello can you drop the new path?)
angelo.devex: done — replaced with /docs/retention/matrix-v2.md and updated anchor
maria.docs: merged and will backfill a short changelog entry in the release notes. Thanks all! :tada:
